DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice.

The clinical picture of a well-appearing 2-week-old infant with exclusively breastfed status and worsening jaundice, combined with normal weight gain (3066g to 3200g), strongly supports this diagnosis. Since the direct bilirubin and Coombs test results were pending in your previous message, we can now conclude that the indirect hyperbilirubinemia is likely due to decreased enteral intake or increased enterohepatic circulation rather than hemolysis.
